performance.driver: Revenue increased 13% to $717.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $634.5 million for the same period in 2025, attributable to higher revenue in our nurse and allied solutions segment.

Revenue Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $1,023.6 million, as compared to $956.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, an increase of $67.6 million or 7%. The increase in revenue was primarily attributable to capitation revenue which increased by 9% primarily as a result of enrollees transitioning to full risk through our Restricted Knox-Keene licensed health plans (“RKKs”).

Revenues increased by $3.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 over the prior year comparable period. The increase was due to an increase of $5.1 million or 9% in our Corporate business, partially offset by a decline of $1.9 million or 6% in our SoHo business.

Total revenues increased $1.3 billion and $872 million during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, respectively, compared to the corresponding periods in 2025 primarily due to the Cox Transactions which increased revenues by $1.4 billion.

Total revenues increased 53% to $759.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and 57% to $2,251.7 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the respective prior-year periods, driven primarily by growth in our Medicare Advantage membership and higher per-member premium.

Revenue increased by $185.0 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to higher revenue from our Sportsbook and prediction markets offerings (together, “Sports”), driven by higher Sportsbook handle and higher Sportsbook net revenue margin, partially offset by promotional investment associated with the launch of our prediction markets offering.

Total net sales for the three months ended October 2, 2026 decreased $38.0 million, or 10.1%, compared to the three months ended October 3, 2025. The decrease in net sales is driven by limited chassis availability for our upfit businesses, macroeconomic conditions impacting dealers and consumers, order timing, and channel destocking in response to market-wide economic conditions, and lost revenues from divested businesses, partially offset by strengthening demand across powersports products.

performance.driver: Total revenues increased from $408.2 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025 to $451.7 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, representing an 11% year-over-year increase. The increase in year-over-year revenue growth was driven by the strong performance by our sales team.

Revenue increased $59.5 million, or 4.0%, to $1,557.4 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $1,498.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase was driven by continued demand for our services and products across all three major end markets.

Revenues, consisting principally of interest income on loans, increased by $70.2 million in the nine months of 2026, primarily due to increases in interest income from loans of $59.0 million and rental income from foreclosed properties of $33.5 million, partially offset by a decrease in interest income from investment securities of $20.9 million.

Operating income increased 9.7% to $16.3 million for the three months ended October 2, 2026, compared to an operating income of $14.9 million for the three months ended October 3, 2025, as a result of the factors noted above.
